scope: A separate full dodge firmware is built with preserved board memory/SimpleFb patches and the fresh-entropy DarwinBoot source override. All 53 generated EFI headers and 100 embedded executable images are structurally checked. Bounded FV/FFS/LZMA/header checksums pass; the exact new DarwinBoot EFI and unchanged donor RNG bytes are read back from the actual FD. That embedded EFI, with its actual link map, executes the same two success/six failure/two instruction controls and native seed-to-original-18-test-POST/consumer chain. An Android v4 container carries this FD and the byte-identical preserved 160 MiB crypto development FAT/packed Data input. Actual bootimg gzip/shim/FD/DTB/FAT/header readback passes. Firmware/allocator/RNG/console/ExitBootServices are explicit CPU peers; no proprietary provider entropy health, physical services, handoff assembly, full kernel/root/Data/userspace boot or phone operation is qualified. Existing firmware, payloads and boot images are preserved.
